notes.title: [Community News] Announcing the Winners of the 2024 Second Annual Goldy Awards
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43695402/87cec02794daaaf71db07b157d2dc16e9231da42.jpg[/img]

The HUMANITY Stage Creator community continues to create and upload amazing stages, and the 2024 Second Annual Goldy Awards aims to recognize some of the best contributions made over the last year. 

Thousands of HUMANITY stages were uploaded in 2024, and we selected just a handful of nominees for each of the nine award categories. For the first time, this year’s Goldy Awards includes two special categories celebrating Breakthrough Creator and Creator of the Year. 

We just announced the winners of the awards on our weekly HUMANITY Hub Community Stream. You can [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/sq7D4Fat-Gk]watch a VOD of the broadcast here[/url] on the Enhance Experience YouTube channel.

Congratulations to all the nominees and winners. We hope you and all the existing and new players coming to the game continue to make and play stages in 2025!

If your stage won an award and you want a physical award, please contact [u]support@enhance-experience.com[/u] to confirm your identity by March 1, 2025. 

[previewyoutube=sq7D4Fat-Gk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.notes:

Today kicks off the 2024 Second Annual Goldy Awards, an event showcasing the best community-made content in HUMANITY. We’ve put together a collection of over 100 stages across 11 different categories. Play the game, rate and favorite your picks, and help us celebrate these fantastic creations. [url=https://forms.gle/Cusdhszft6UYdKCJ9]This year, the community will vote for BEST PUZZLE GAME by voting here[/url]. A combination of gameplay data and selection by the Enhance Community Team will determine the remaining categories. The creators of the winning entries will receive a physical Shiba and Goldy figure set!

[h3]CATEGORIES[/h3]
The 2024 categories are:

BEST PUZZLE STAGE
BEST FOLLOW STAGE
BEST PLATFORMING STAGE
BEST HOMAGE / ADAPTATION
BEST OTHERS STAGE
BEST DIFFICULT STAGE
MOST INNOVATIVE STAGE
ACHIEVEMENT IN ARTISTIC DESIGN
BEST CREATOR SEQUENCE(S)
BREAKTHROUGH CREATOR
CREATOR(S) OF THE YEAR

A complete playlist of all the nominated stages is available in-game (PLAY STAGES from the title screen) and can be played like its own campaign. Category playlists will rotate in and out between now and the end of January 2025.

Nominees and finalists are determined through gameplay data (players, favorites, ratings, etc.) and Enhance Community Team selection. [url=https://forms.gle/Cusdhszft6UYdKCJ9]BEST PUZZLE STAGE will be determined by community votes here.[/url]

Winning stages will be announced via the HUMANITY Hub Community Stream at twitch.tv/EnhanceExperience (time/date TBD). Winning creators must contact Enhance at support@enhance-experience.com and confirm their identity by March 1, 2025 to receive a physical award.

==================================
[h3]ELIGIBILITY[/h3]
The Enhance Community Team / Goldy Awards committee considered and determined the shortlist of stages per category from the available playable stages as of November 31, 2024. If a nominated stage is removed, edited, or altered in any way, it may no longer be eligible.

[h3]JUDGING & VOTING[/h3]
Starting December 20, 2024, players will be able to vote for BEST PUZZLE STAGE via [url=https://forms.gle/Cusdhszft6UYdKCJ9]https://forms.gle/Cusdhszft6UYdKCJ9[/url]. Winners for other categories will be determined through gameplay data (players, favorites, ratings, etc.) and Enhance Community Team selection.

Winning stages will be announced via stream (time/date TBD) at twitch.tv/EnhanceExperience. Winning creators must contact Enhance at support@enhance-experience.com and confirm their identity by March 1, 2025 to receive a physical award.

A set of 1 Shiba and 1 Goldy statue with the winner’s stage and category etched into it and a customized thank you card.

Good luck to all the nominated creators!

notes.title: [Community News] July 2024 Stage Jam: JOURNEY
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43695402/035659c68e9871201b3a7a886c6c4837c0fd0223.jpg[/img]

HUMANITY Stage Jams invite our expanding community of USER STAGES designers to craft new levels based on a central theme. For July 2024, the theme is JOURNEY, encouraging creators to design larger stages featuring grand structures and numerous puzzles!

Creators have been making these types of stages since the game launched in 2023, but only recently have we dubbed them “journeys” due to the usually massive size and time it takes to complete one of these stages for the first time. These stages often include smaller puzzles housed inside a structure or environment that the player and the humans must traverse.

Some examples of stages fitting the Journey theme include TOP-DOWN TOMB by LetsGOseph (Stage ID: 112-505-4678), SKYSCRAPERS by HatlessConnor (Stage ID: 207-597-1331), and TEMPLE OF LIGHT by Teksum (Stage ID: 202-005-5877). Use the SEARCH tab inside USER STAGES to find and play these stages to get a taste of what Journeys are for yourself. We can’t wait to see more creators try their hand at making one of these epic HUMANITY adventures.

Join the Enhance Discord server at https://discord.gg/enhance and share your creations in the #share-a-stage channel, chat with other creators in #creator-workshop, and join our Stage Jam Hangout event (Saturday, 7/13, at noon Pacific time). Discuss stage creation ideas, learn more about creating stages, or play stages together.

Throughout July, we’ll also be streaming JOURNEY stages during our weekly HUMANITY Hub Community Streams. Follow [url=https://www.twitch.tv/EnhanceExperience]our Twitch[/url] and/or [url=https://www.youtube.com/@EnhanceExperience]YouTube channel[/url] to be notified when we go live (typically Wednesdays at 4 pm Eastern / 1 pm Pacific).

[h3]JULY 2024 STAGE JAM: JOURNEY[/h3]

[u][b]How to participate (it’s simple!):[/b][/u]

📖 Create and upload new stages (not something previously shared, please) inspired by the monthly theme. Feel free to interpret the theme any way you want!

🏷️ Don’t forget to share with the monthly Stage Jam tag (in this case, it’s JOURNEY JAM)

✏️ Share your jam creations in #share-a-stage and works in progress in #creator-workshop on Discord.

🎮 Play and discuss stages made by other creators.

🗣️ Join our monthly HUMANITY / Stage Jam Discord Hangout (Saturday, 7/13, at noon Pacific time).

[u][b]Jam guidelines:[/b][/u]

- We ask that participating stages be new creations designed after the jam theme’s announcement, not something that you have already created or uploaded.
- Have fun, and encourage others who are designing.

[url=https://humanity.game/community_news/community-news-the-2023-first-annual-goldy-awards-spotlights-the-best-of-humanitys-user-stages]We announced the nominees for this prestigious award in December[/url] and invited players to play, rate, and favorite their picks in ten categories. A combination of this social voting, in-game metrics, and internal Enhance community team deliberations determined the final winners. The winners were announced on January 24, 2024 via a special HUMANITY Hub Community Stream [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zEArgRr3CYk](watch the replay here).[/url]

If your stage won an award and you want a physical award, please contact support@enhance-experience.com to confirm your identity by March 1, 2024.

notes.title: [Community News] The 2023 Goldy Awards Spotlights The Best USER STAGES
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43695402/0b8fa52e28b0b3e27451bd443a4f3db29940bf77.png[/img]

Today kicks off the 2023 First Annual Goldy Awards, showcasing the best community-made content in HUMANITY. We’ve put together a collection of 100 stages across 10 different categories. Play the game, rate and favorite your picks, and help us celebrate these fantastic creations. The ultimate winners for each category will be determined by a combination of gameplay data, selection by the Enhance Community Team, and social media voting. The creators of the winning entries will receive a physical Shiba and Goldy figure set!

[h3]CATEGORIES[/h3]
The first five categories are available as playlists inside USER STAGES now:

[list][*] BEST PUZZLE STAGE
[*] BEST PUZZLE (START SWITCH) STAGE
[*] BEST FOLLOW STAGE
[*] BEST DIFFICULT STAGE
[*] MOST INNOVATIVE STAGE[/list]

An additional five categories will be available starting on December 29, 2023:

[list][*] BEST HOMAGE / ADAPTATION STAGE
[*] ACHIEVEMENT IN ARTISTIC DESIGN
[*] BEST PLATFORMING STAGE
[*] BEST OTHERS STAGE
[*] BEST MACHINES STAGE[/list]

Each group will be available as in-game playlists for a week.

==================================
[h3]ELIGIBILITY[/h3]
The Enhance Community Team / Goldy Awards committee considered and determined the shortlist of 10 stages per category from the available playable stages as of December 20, 2023. If a nominated stage is removed, edited, or altered in any way, it may no longer be eligible.

[h3]JUDGING & VOTING[/h3]
Starting January 5, 2024, four finalists in each category will be announced each weekday (for a total of 10 days for 10 categories) via social media at [url=https://twitter.com/HumanityGame]x.com/humanitygame[/url]. The community will have 3 days to vote via the poll posted for each category. The two groups of 5 categories will rotate through the in-game playlists again. The current category will be featured as an in-game playlist on its polling day.

Nominees and finalists are determined through a combination of gameplay data (players, favorites, ratings, etc.) and Enhance Community Team selection. Social media voting will only be used as an additional factor alongside those to select the ultimate winner of each category.

[h3]WINNERS[/h3]
Winning stages will be announced via stream on January 24, 2024 at [url=https://www.twitch.tv/EnhanceExperience]twitch.tv/EnhanceExperience[/url]. Winning creators must contact Enhance at [url=mailto:support@enhance-experience.com]support@enhance-experience.com[/url] and confirm their identity by March 1, 2024 to receive a physical award.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43695402/1d237b4074e3df954e5f70e35cfa53f071a32c85.jpg[/img]

[h3]PRIZES[/h3]
A set of 1 Shiba and 1 Goldy statue with the winner’s stage and category etched into it and a customized thank you card.

Good luck to all the nominated creators!

The HUMANITY Hub community stream is live every Wednesday. Next week we'll dive further into the STORY MODE and community-made stages. Stay tuned to our X account or your newsfeed on PlayStation and Steam to find out when we're going live.

[h2]Next Discord Creator Workshop: SPRAWLING[/h2]

This next Creator Workshop theme is SPRAWLING—stages that are large in scope. Maybe it's multiple small puzzles or one big set piece, we're looking levels that stretch the boundaries of creating in HUMANITY.  Be sure to tag your stage with "SPRAWLING" to participate, and join our Discord community at discord.gg/Enhance and share your creations with us!

[h2]People-Pathing Pointers[/h2]

Ah yes, the flow of HUMANITY. People walk out of a gate, and you must deal with their numbers (at least in most stages)! Pathing these hordes can prove tricky in some situations. Here are some pro people-pathing pointers for these precarious predicaments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43695402/1236855883b7ad610ebc8b16c928497c44d7e84c.jpg[/img]

Let's say you must keep a People Switch activated while pathing humans elsewhere. Creating a loop of humans over the switch will ensure it stays activated. Note the more people that flow into a circle, the more likely it is to become so crowded it overflows, with humans straying in all directions. Try not to let that happen! (Unless you want to on purpose—we'll discuss "Overflow" in a future post.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43695402/3bb1445b6837862f9dd4abff08c9b2260f9d0adc.jpg[/img]

If you don't have the surface area for a complete circle, you can still make them walk back and forth. However, even with a smaller group, you may find that as humans collide, they'll randomly stray off the path, so this method is much less reliable than looping them. Their numbers may eventually not be enough to keep a switch active.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43695402/202cb0a211bc45e178b2d79fb7af02562256796e.jpg[/img]

Maybe you're moving a lot of Pushable Blocks amongst intersecting paths of humans. Segmenting a group of 5-10 humans away from an always-marching flow can help. Send the rest off the edge of the stage (temporarily!) and you should have enough room to work! You need at least five people to push a Pushable Block. This is especially handy on a stage like Sequence 2's THE WALL where space is limited and you don't want to chance a rogue stream of humans ruining the positions of your Pushable Blocks.

And that's it for this installment of HUMANITY Community News! Join us on Wednesdays every week for our HUMANITY Hub Community Streams. Live on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/EnhanceExperience]Twitch[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@EnhanceExperience]YouTube[/url], and Steam, or check [url=https://www.youtube.com/@EnhanceExperience/streams]our YouTube channel for the VODs[/url] afterward.

4,131 user stages played
2,447 stages with all Goldy collected
Over 500 hours played
400,000 XP required for max level

And whether you share that nostalgia or not, or were even gaming back then, we hope you’ll enjoy that same spirit in Humanity: stylish and different, but with a deeply satisfying game at the core.

notes.title: Get the most out of the HUMANITY Demo with these tips
notes.notes:
HUMANITY is an action-puzzle game that combines traffic flow puzzles with 3D platforming. The demo we just released (you have downloaded it, right?) features 10 stages—a sample of what can be found in the full game. Here are some tips to get you through!

[b]Tell the humans to walk faster[/b]
Hold down Shift on the keyboard or R2/right trigger on a controller and make the horde of humans go faster. A must for testing out routes in either the Demo's levels or user-made stages.

[b]Simplify simplify simplify[/b]
A lifehack if ever there was one but it also applies in-game to HUMANITY! If you suddenly have a lot of commands littered all over the ground, you're probably making the situation just a little bit more complicated than it needs to be. Try deleting the directions that you know definitely are not the simplest/shortest route and go from there.

[b]Retry to clear your head[/b]
Sometimes, we all need a reset button. There is no penalty in retrying stages, and sometimes getting a clear view of the goal can help you create a practical action plan. There we go giving life advice again, but it's worth remembering in the game!

[b]Soul-surfing can be a lifesaver[/b]
Some of the jumps in HUMANITY are maybe just a little too far. Remember that the Shiba can soul-surf within the people. Just hit jump, then jump again to join with the stream of people, then navigate amongst them freely. Use that to get to ledges when a standard jump can't quite get you there. Press jump once to exit the people.

[b]A better way to judge jumps[/b]
As you frolic and hop around each stage as the Shiba, note the little dot of light shown on the ground below you. This will help you judge long jumps or jumps from high surfaces. If you jump and don't see the marker on a surface, you're not going to make it! Ahhhhhhh!

[b]You can't command the Others[/b]
In the demo, you'll meet the Others, a rival group to the humans you're currently leading. Try as you might, you won't be able to influence the Others' path. When your humans wade into a path of Others they can lose their way a bit, and if you're escorting Goldy, they'll run off! Try to clear a path instead.

[previewyoutube=SmluKv-1S8g;full][/previewyoutube]

Now go forth and clear the stages in the demo, hopefully with these tips fresh in your mind! Having trouble? Join our Discord (https://discord.gg/enhance) and follow us on Twitter (twitter.com/HumanityGame) for more on HUMANITY.

notes.title: HUMANITY is coming May 2023, play the demo right now for a limited time
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We just announced that HUMANITY is coming to Steam in May 2023. But you don't have to wait to play; we've just released a limited-time demo that is playable between now and March 6, 2023. It's also perfect for Steam Deck. So head over to our store page, start that download and continue reading!

In HUMANITY you become a Shiba Inu (dog) tasked with leading a massive, marching crowd to goals in each stage. You can place commands on the ground to make them jump, turn, push, float, and climb their way to salvation. This is action-puzzle gameplay that mixes a bit of platforming and crowd control. 

This demo features 10 stages, giving you a sample of what to expect from the full version. In addition, you can check out the User Stages area, an ever-growing library of new content created by the community. Whether you're looking for artful stages that take the building blocks of HUMANITY and do something amazing with it or you're looking for tough-as-nails challenges, you're likely to find it here. Playing and finishing stages will raise your player level.

Speaking of community content, the demo also features a beta of our Stage Creator. Hop in and try your hand at creating all kinds of stages in HUMANITY, using the same tools that we used to create the full version's campaign! Anyone can make a stage, and we are looking forward to seeing what you can do. The demo is also available on PlayStation and created levels can be played cross-platform. We've got a topic in the Steam Discussion forum where you can share your Stage IDs with us.

Find out more about the game on the web at humanity.game, wishlist HUMANITY on Steam now to keep up to date, and play the demo and let us know what you think.

Thanks!!
